output.reason: The release-note line [ev-4555b462d2c6] is only a commit title, but the linked PR [ev-e98e7bf86a86] fills in what it leaves out. Subject: resource-tracking normalization in util/argo/resource_tracking.go [ev-46c367059a1f][ev-531bcc175476]. Change: it is no longer applied to live CRDs, because "CRDs should not have resource annotations set on them". Consequence and exposure: before the fix, this normalization caused wrong diffs for applications that manage CRDs while using ServerSideDiff, and [ev-4dad3f99fe26] confirms the 3.0 cherry-pick carries this fix. One gap: the evidence never names the configuration key that turns on ServerSideDiff, so the applicability condition has to be written at the level of "ServerSideDiff is in use and the app manages CRDs".
